REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 18, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk

a.

c.

d.

a.

2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL 7
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l, be approved.

Consideration and possible approval of a resolution approving the destruction of certain obsolete City records in accordance with Section 34090 of the California Government Code
RES 2017-07 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN CITY OBSOLETE RECORDS IN ACCORDANCE WITH SECTION 34090 OF THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE.
ACTION: That the City Council approve said resolution approving the destruction of certain obsolete City records in accordance with Section 34090 of the California Government Code.
Item #7j
k.
Consideration of adoption of Resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2016-2018 and a resolution ordering the Public Works Director/City Engineer to prepare the Engineer's Report
RES 2017-08 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, DECLARING THE INTENT OF THE CITY COUNCIL TO LEVY AND COLLECT ASSESSMENTS WITHIN THE LOMITA LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 FOR FISCAL YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2017 AND ENDING IN JUNE 30, 2018, AND SETTING A PUBLIC HEARING DATE FOR MAY 16, 2017.
RES 2017-09 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ORDERING THE PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR/CITY ENGINEER TO PREPARE AND FILE THE ENGINEER'S REPORT FOR LOMITA LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING ACT OF 1972, BEING DIVISION 15, PART 2 OF THE STREETS AND HIGHWAYS CODE OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA, FOR FISCAL YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2017 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2018.
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council:
1)
Consider adoption of a resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, and set a public hearing date for May 16, 2017; and
2)
Consider adoption of a Resolution directing the Public Works Director/City Engineer to prepare the Engineer's Report for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Item #7k
l.
Consideration and possible approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Management Partners for facilitated strategic planning.
ACTION: That the City Council Authorize the City Manager to execute the Professional Services Agreement with Management Partners for facilitated strategic planning in an amount not to exceed $10,500.
Item #7l
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
SCHEDULE A DATE(S) AND TIME(S) FOR THE STRATEGIC PLANNING WORKSHOP
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council select two different dates - one for individual meetings with the facilitator, and one for the Strategic Planning Workshop:
Individual Interviews with Council Members:
Monday, May 1, 2017,
Tuesday, May 2, 2017, or
Wednesday, May 3, 2017

PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO CONDITINALLY PERMITTING "BREWPUBS" WITHIN DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL AND COMMERCIAL GENERAL ZONES AND REVIEW OF A PROPOSED BREWPUB AT 24516 NARBONNE AVENUE
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ORD NO. 787 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING SECTION 11-1.15.02(B), SECTION 11-1.49.04(2), SECTION 11-1.45.05(6), AND SECTION 11-1.66.03 TO DEFINE, PERMIT, AND SET PARKING STANDARDS FOR A "BREWPUB" WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) AND COMMERCIAL GENERAL (C-G) ZONE SUBJECT TO A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT AND DELETING SECTION 11-1.56.04 (CONSUMPTION) IN ITS ENTIRETY. (First Reading)
RES 2017-10 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 302 TO ALLOW A NEW 3,000 SQUARE FOOT BREWPUB WITH OUTDOOR DINING, FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 24516 NARBONNE AVENUE IN THE D-C, DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE. (Initiated and filed by Burning Daylight Brewing Company, c/o Robert Lake, 741 Avenue A, Redondo Beach, CA 90277.)
7
1)
Introduced first reading of an ordinance amending Section 11-1.15.01(B), Section 11-1.49.04(2), Section 11-1.45.05(6), and Section 11-1.66.03 to define, permit and set parking standards for a "Brewpub" within the Downtown Commercial (D-C) and Commercial General (C-G) zone subject to a conditional use permit and deleting Section 11-1.56.04 (Consumption) in it entirely; and
2)
Adoption of resolution approving Conditional Use Permit No. 302 to allow a new 3,000 square foot brewpub with associated outdoor dining.
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Dorothy Gazeley to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, May 2, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
